text:
Very disappointed with McDonald’s Bukit Bintang, I order through McDelivery but I did not received everything that I ordered.
The rider just pass me 3 cups of drink and 1 bag, at the first point I realized does all my food can fit in 1 bag? Then I check with the rider “is everything in this bag?” And rider said “yes”, during the time I was quite busy at my work and I did not have much time to open the bag and check the order while I was holding 3 cups on another hand.
When I open the bag once the rider left I noticed Double Spicy Chicken w cheese burger is not there.
Immediately I try to call the branch where I got the number from google but it’s voicemail and I notice on the bill it shows another number but it’s voicemail too.
I send email and call to McDonald hotline still everything is out of working hours.

Who’s going to take the responsibility for my money?
Is McDonald staff can simply cheat consumers money who make an order on night?
Most of the McDonald branch is open till 2/3am but why their hotline is till 9pm?

I believe McDonald will take serious action on the person who handle my order.

Very bad service and very disappointing, this type of mistake shouldn’t be happening in F&B industry.
Cheating people food which is I paid.

text:

When the supervisor asked for the receipt, the counter staff acted as if the receipt is missing until we pointed it out that we saw what she did.

3. Service Attitude - The counter staff took it out on our order and gave us less fries. Please see the image as attached.

text:
I would’ve given zero stars if I could.
We ordered two burgers, fries, drinks, and apple pies. When we got back to our hotel, we realized that one burger was missing and had been replaced with a rice meal we never ordered. We didn’t touch the food and immediately went back to McDonald’s to fix the mistake.

We asked if they could give us the missing burger and change the rest of the food since it had gone cold. They only gave us the missing burger and changed the other burger but refused to replace the other items.

We also asked for the drinks to be replaced because the ice had melted, and they were watered down. The staff just took the drinks to the back and brought them back unchanged, it was obvious nothing had been done.

Very disappointing service and careless attitude. Not what you expect from McDonald’s
author: Zara Al

text: Came here around 2pm today after shopping at Pavillion. None of their kiosks were working so I had to order at the counter. The lady taking my order was careless and laughing and singing as I was placing my order… incredibly rude and unprofessional. Despite that I ordered the spicy deluxe with fries and my sisters had their beef burgers with fries. My burger was brown and tasted rotten, fries were ICE COLD AND LIMP and my sister’s burgers were dry, lukewarm and full of salt. I spoke to the manager before leaving and he did not even apologize or seem to care. We have a flight back to Canada in a few hours and I can’t imagine how sick we would have been if we ate this disgusting food. Absolutely no idea how this place has 4 stars. DO NOT COME HERE

text: It was one of the worst McDonalds that we have ever had a meal.  I went there as a family for breakfast on a Sunday at 10 am, and they had such a slow service even though there were only few customers, staffs are not able to communicate well with their customer when they miss our order, there was NO coffee for morning breakfast, and finally the place was so filty as the floors were dirty , the ventilation was poor and the chlorox smell from the cleaning was so overwhelming . I think it's very disappointing as this outlet is right in the middle of the city where locals and many tourists would come by easily. Please improve your hygiene and efficiency.

text:
I understand that weekends are very busy, and I truly sympathize with all the staff who are working hard—I can see everyone was occupied with their own tasks. However, at the McCafé counter, there was absolutely no one stationed there, and I ended up waiting more than 15 minutes just for a coffee.

The main point isn’t the waiting time itself, but the fact that there was literally no one attending to the McCafé station during that period. I believe this is more of a management issue rather than the fault of the staff. The management should really pay more attention to how the workflow and manpower are arranged to ensure smoother service.
author: Content Ravius

text:
AVOID!!! I recently visited McDonald's at Bukit Bintang in Kuala Lumpur during my first trip to the city, and I have to say, this was one of the worst experiences I’ve ever had at a McDonald's. After waiting over two hours for my order, I went to the location in person to find out what was going on. The staff didn’t apologize or show any concern—instead, they treated me with complete disrespect and didn’t seem to care that I’d been waiting so long.

For any fellow tourists out there, I’d strongly advise staying far away from this McDonald’s location. Kuala Lumpur has plenty of other dining options with much better service.
